project.name: ServiceKU
project.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for repair shop and retail store management in Indonesia

nodes.name: Service Order Management
nodes.summary: Core business domain handling the full lifecycle of repair service orders: device check-in, technician assignment, repair work, customer confirmation, pickup, and warranty claims. Supports 12 status transitions and partner outsourcing.

businessRules: Service travels through 12 statuses in defined workflow
Warranty claims must reference a paid parent service

nodes.name: Sales & Point of Sale
nodes.summary: Handles all sales transactions: direct POS sales, service-based billing, and indent pre-orders with draft-to-paid workflow, PDF invoice generation, payment tracking, and void/return capability.

businessRules: Sales progress via draft -> paid -> cancel
Stock deducted on paid, restored on void

nodes.name: Inventory & Supply Chain
nodes.summary: Manages product catalog, stock levels, purchase orders from suppliers, supplier management, stock transfers between branches, reorder alerts, stock forecasting, damaged stock tracking, and purchase returns.

businessRules: Low stock alerts when below min_stock

nodes.name: Finance & Accounting
nodes.summary: Manages operational expenses with photo upload, technician commission auto-calculation, PPN tax configuration, bank payment reconciliation, daily cash deposits, and cash register shift tracking.

businessRules: Daily deposits tracked per cashier shift

nodes.name: HR & Operations
nodes.summary: Employee management with 9 roles, shift definitions, attendance tracking with clock in/out, and pickup/delivery scheduling for customer devices.

businessRules: Each user has one of 9 roles with specific permissions
Attendance tracked per user per day via clock in/out
crossDomainInteractions: Users assigned to Services as technicians

nodes.name: Platform Administration
nodes.summary: Central SaaS platform management: multi-tenant lifecycle via stancl/tenancy, subscription plans with tiered pricing, promo vouchers, feature gating via 4-layer authorization, system monitoring, backup management, and Google Drive integration.

businessRules: Each tenant gets an isolated database
Features controlled by plan + role + custom menus
Google Drive OAuth per tenant with auto-refresh
crossDomainInteractions: All tenant domains depend on this platform
Subscription status gates all tenant operations
Google Drive stores photos for Services and Expenses

nodes.name: Service Order Lifecycle
nodes.summary: End-to-end repair service: device check-in with photos and checklists, technician assignment, repair work with progress updates, customer/internal confirmation, pickup completion, and warranty claims.

nodes.name: POS Sales Transaction
nodes.summary: Create sales from scratch, from completed services, or from indents. Supports draft workflow with item editing, full payment with stock deduction, PDF invoice generation, and voiding with stock restoration.

nodes.name: Purchase & Stocking
nodes.summary: Create purchase orders from suppliers, receive stock with auto-increment, return defective items to supplier with auto-decrement, and manage damaged/reject/expired stock.

nodes.name: Expense & Cash Management
nodes.summary: Record operational expenses with categorized tracking and optional photo attachment. Manage daily cash deposits and cash register shift openings/closings with balance tracking.

nodes.name: Employee Attendance
nodes.summary: Define work shifts per branch, clock in/out for attendance tracking, generate attendance reports with status filtering (hadir/izin/sakit/alpha).

nodes.name: Tenant Onboarding & Authentication
nodes.summary: Register new tenants via OTP verification with auto-created database, login via email/password with tenancy initialization, Google OAuth login, and password reset.

nodes.name: Create Service Order
nodes.summary: CS/owner creates a service order with customer info, device data, check-in checklist, problem description, and optional photos. Smart technician assignment based on store size.

nodes.name: Assign Technician
nodes.summary: Owner manually assigns a technician to a service order, transitioning status from menunggu_alokasi to dikerjakan.

nodes.name: Perform Repair Work
nodes.summary: Technician accepts, starts, and completes repair work. Can request reallocation, customer confirmation, or internal approval during the process.

nodes.name: Customer Confirmation
nodes.summary: Technician requests customer confirmation or internal approval for repair completion. Owner/CS approves to continue.

nodes.name: Complete & Billing
nodes.summary: Service marked ready for pickup, then completed via POS sale. Receipt PDF generated. Warranty period starts.

nodes.name: Warranty Claim
nodes.summary: Create a warranty claim service from a previously completed service within warranty period. Zero-cost service order linked to parent.

nodes.name: Upload Service Photo
nodes.summary: Upload photos of device condition during service. Stored in Google Drive if connected, otherwise disabled.

nodes.name: Create Sale Draft
nodes.summary: Cashier creates a draft sale with customer, items (spareparts/jasa/aksesoris), and optional discount. No stock deducted yet.

nodes.name: Process Payment
nodes.summary: Complete draft or full payment with selected payment method (cash/transfer/QRIS). Stock deducted for spareparts. Service marked paid. PDF invoice generated async.

nodes.name: Void Sale
nodes.summary: Cancel a paid sale. Stock restored for all items. Inventory mutation logged. Sale marked as cancel.

nodes.name: Generate Invoice PDF
nodes.summary: Background job generates a PDF invoice with tenant branding, paper size config, and item details. Stored in public storage.

nodes.name: Draft from Service
nodes.summary: Auto-create a draft sale from a completed service, copying service charge and spareparts as line items.

nodes.name: Create Purchase Order
nodes.summary: Create a purchase order from a supplier with items and pricing. Auto-create or select existing supplier.

nodes.name: Receive Stock
nodes.summary: Receive purchase items and auto-increment stock quantities. Inventory mutation logged.

nodes.name: Return to Supplier
nodes.summary: Return defective items to supplier. Stock auto-decremented. Status workflow: dikirim -> diproses_supplier -> selesai/ditolak.

nodes.name: Stock Adjustment
nodes.summary: Manual stock adjustment for opname: increment or decrement with reason. Mutation logged.

nodes.name: Record Damaged Stock
nodes.summary: Record damaged, rejected, or expired stock from various sources (pembelian, retur_customer, opname). Auto-decrement stock.

nodes.name: Reorder Alerts
nodes.summary: View products where stock_quantity <= min_stock. Triggers reorder notifications.

nodes.name: Stock Forecasting
nodes.summary: Forecast days until stock empty based on 3-month usage history. Flags items needing restock within 30 days.

nodes.name: Record Expense
nodes.summary: Record operational expense with description, amount, date, category (operasional/gaji/listrik/sewa/marketing/lainnya), and optional photo.

nodes.name: Calculate Commission
nodes.summary: Auto-calculate technician commission per completed service. Tracks pending/paid status.

nodes.name: Pay Commission
nodes.summary: Mark commissions as paid individually or in bulk. Records payer and payment timestamp.

nodes.name: Reconcile Payment
nodes.summary: Match sale payments with bank statements. Track bank name, reference number, and reconciliation status.

nodes.name: Configure PPN Tax
nodes.summary: Set PKP/non-PKP status, NPWP number, and PPN percentage (default 11%). Calculate PPN on given amounts.

nodes.name: Clock In/Out
nodes.summary: Employees clock in at shift start and clock out at shift end. Records attendance for the day.

nodes.name: Attendance Report
nodes.summary: Generate attendance reports grouped by employee, showing clock in/out times and status.

nodes.name: Define Shifts
nodes.summary: Define employee work shifts per branch with name, start time, and end time.

nodes.name: Register Tenant
nodes.summary: Multi-step registration: form -> send OTP -> verify OTP -> auto-create tenant database with branch, owner user, and default settings.

nodes.name: Login
nodes.summary: Email/password login with tenant store lookup, tenancy initialization, rate limiting (6/min), and login history recording.

nodes.name: Google OAuth Login
nodes.summary: Login with Google via Socialite. First-time login links Google account. Can also link/unlink from profile.

nodes.name: Reset Password
nodes.summary: Send password reset email with token. Verify token and set new password.

nodes.name: Manage Tenant Lifecycle
nodes.summary: Super admin manages tenants: CRUD, suspend/activate, change plan, extend trial, impersonate login, reset password, sync stats.

nodes.name: Manage Plans
nodes.summary: Super admin manages subscription plans: pricing, promos, features, business types, and default menus per role.

nodes.name: Manage Vouchers
nodes.summary: Super admin creates promo voucher codes with discounts, usage limits, and date ranges.

nodes.name: Feature Gate Check
nodes.summary: 4-layer authorization: plan features -> user role -> custom menu access -> default menus. Applied to every route via middleware.

edges.description: Completed services create draft sales for billing
Sales deduct stock and create mutations
Sales drive payment reconciliation and deposits
Platform provides Google Drive storage for service photos
Plan feature gates control inventory feature access
